newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lurgi to cut staff by 10 percent.
newsitem.headline: Lurgi to cut staff by 10 percent.

text.p: German oil, gas and chemical company Lurgi AG said on Monday it wants to cut about 10 percent of jobs in the 1996/97 business year to September 30.
Around 400 employees out of the current payroll of 4,000 workers would lose their jobs, said Lurgi, which is a subsidiary of the German metals and trading company Metallgesellschaft AG.

The Lurgi committee told representatives of the workers on Monday about the job cuts, which will be predominantly in its oil, gas and chemical unit Lurgi Oel Gas Chemie GmbH and its environmental unit Lurgi Umwelt GmbH.

Lurgi said it had been forced to make the cuts to maintain competitiveness but said the decline in costs which would come from the redundancies should contribute to the long-term security of remaining jobs.
